The term "grand alignment" can refer to various celestial events where multiple planets appear aligned from Earth's perspective. In 2025, several notable planetary alignments are scheduled:

- **January 21, 2025**: A planetary alignment featuring Mars, Jupiter, Uranus, Neptune, Venus, and Saturn will be visible in the evening sky. The optimal viewing time varies by location; for instance, in New York, the best view is expected on January 22, when the planets occupy a 152-degree sector of the sky. citeturn0search1

- **January 25, 2025**: A significant celestial event, often referred to as the "Great Celestial Alignment," will occur, with key planets such as Venus, Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn appearing to converge visually along the same region of the sky, creating an enchanting line visible to the naked eye. citeturn0search3

- **February 28, 2025**: Another alignment will feature seven planets—Saturn, Mercury, Neptune, Venus, Uranus, Jupiter, and Mars—visible together in the night sky. citeturn0news13

Given your location in Glendale, Arizona, these alignments should be observable, provided you have clear skies and minimal light pollution. For the best viewing experience, find an open area with an unobstructed view of the horizon, away from city lights. Using a stargazing app can help you identify and locate the planets during these events.

For a visual explanation of the January 25, 2025, alignment, you might find this video helpful:

videoThe Great Planetary Alignment of January 25, 2025turn0search4
